_note: Pixel particle physics and living floor pixels (src/vfx/particles.gd). Particles fly in the floor plane with a height above it. gravity: px/s^2 pulling the height down; bounce: share of the fall speed kept when a particle hits the floor (below bounce_min px/s it stops); wall_bounce: share of the speed kept when it hits a wall cell; ground_friction: extra drag per second while sliding on the floor; settle_speed: below this px/s a resting debris particle becomes a floor pixel for good; spawn_height: default height in px of a burst above the floor point under it. modes: gravity (factor of gravity, negative rises), lift ([min, max] upward px/s at the start), settle (lands and stays as a floor pixel), glow (lights up in the bloom layer, at glow_alpha strength, 0.32 when absent), fade (fades out over its life instead of staying solid). max_particles caps the live particles (the oldest settles or vanishes first). kick: blasts lift floor pixels again; every loose debris pixel in reach flies, a pool or stain pixel only with stain_share; speed px/s at the centre, lift [min, max] px/s, at most max_particles per blast. liquid: splats keep creeping outwards; spread_rate pixels per second per pool, budget_scale x the splat's pixel radius squared = pixels it may still try, reach_scale x radius = how far from its centre, dry_after s after it stops it dries darker by dry_darken; max_pools spread at once (the oldest dries first). ember: glowing floor pixels left by fire, life [min, max] s, smoke_rate puffs per second at full heat, colours hot to cool, soot left behind, at most max. frost: frost pixels melt to water after melt_after [min, max] s, water dries away after evaporate_after s (+-30 %), at most max waiting. smoke_color: colour of smoke puffs. Purely visual.

fire._note: Flames (particles.gd flames, fire_burst): ramp hot to cool (a flame runs down it as it ages), life [min, max] s, size [small, big] crypt px, smoke_chance a dying flame leaves a puff of smoke, burst_per_px / burst_max flames of a fire burst by its radius. Buoyancy and lift: modes.flame. User request 2026-10-30: fire as physics.

ice._note: Rigid ice (particles.gd shatter, rime_grow): ramp spec, lite, body, shade, deep; a shard on the floor loses slide_decel px/s every second (dry friction: it skids a short way and stops) plus friction (1/s; ground_friction is 9), keeps bounce of its fall and leaves a frost fleck where it strikes the floor, breaks into chips when it hits a wall faster than shatter_speed px/s, scratches a frost pixel every scratch_every px it slides (0: no trail); rime is a frost crust rime_core of its reach wide (thick in the middle, loose crystals at its rim; rime_fill: how full, share of its pixels by how near the middle) with rime_branches times the asked ferns, rime_reach of the reach long, leaning rime_axis towards the floor joints, growing rime_rate art px/s, at most rime_max growths at once. User request 2026-10-30: ice as physics.

void._note: The void (particles.gd well, implode): ramp spec, lite, body, shade, deep; an implosion pulls with implode_pull px/s inwards and implode_spin round for implode_time s, then shows a frame of void and throws a pressure ring. Motes are streaks (modes.mote). User request 2026-10-30: void energy as physics.

elements._note: Colours of the remaining elements (particles.gd sparks, rubble, dust_flat, holy, shadow): spark streaks, stone (lit top, body, dark bottom), dust, holy light and gold, shadow (ink, its cold violet rim); shadow_hold s a grown shadow holds still, shadow_back s it takes to draw back into its pool tip first. User request 2026-10-30: all elements as physics.

blow._note: A pressure front (shockwave ring, scream sound) shoving pixels outward as it passes (particles.gd blow): hop [min, max] px/s upward for what lies on the floor, max_lift floor pixels (embers, loose rubble) lifted per call. glut mode: a glowing pixel (a blown ember, a lava drop) that falls and lies down again as an ember; over a sinking liquid (set_sink, the hell's lava) it is gone.
